item.title: The EBA advises on targeted simplifications to Taxonomy disclosures
item.description: The European Banking Authority (EBA) has published its response to the European Commission’s Call for Technical Advice on certain key performance indicators (KPIs) and other aspects of the Disclosures Delegated Act under Article 8 of the Taxonomy Regulation. The EBA advises on targeted changes to streamline disclosure requirements, reduce complexity and enhance the usability of information disclosed by credit institutions and investment firms. — Thématique réglementation ; source jugée fiable (european banking authority) ; impact réglementaire.
